newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania c.bank raises refinancing funds on offer.
newsitem.headline: Romania c.bank raises refinancing funds on offer.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Thursday it had raised its refinancing funds on offer to 660 billion lei from 510 billion and kept unchanged at 226 percent the minimum permitted rate for auctioned credits.
Last week an oversubscription for the BNR's one-week funds had sent the average auctioned rate to 426.50 percent from a previous 226.35.

The BNR had previously said that the minimum permitted rate would be set by the market at the weekly auctions. But on Thursday, when the valid rate should have been around 426 percent, the BNR kept the rate flat at 226 percent.
Central bank officials were not immediately available for comment.

Traders said Thursday's move reflected an easing in the BNR drive to tighten monetary policy, as the bank was seeking to calm down pressure on the money market which is plagued by chronical leu shortages.
Short-term rates were near 500 percent in early trading.
Results of the refinancing auction are due later on Thursday.
